dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Did you hear that voice?
Ah, the torment~... You will suffer with me~!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Could it be... a spirit that's haunting this place?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oohhh~ We're not here to bother you, uh no need to torment us! We'll even ask someone at the Grand Narukami Shrine to come and free you... hehe!
